ops.body: Round-6 refuter on df1b9460 (neutral phrasing — no filter trip; verifier independently re-enumerated before reading codex's reconstruction): S4 enumeration COMPLETE AND HONEST (zero missed sites; blanket usd/cost regex over every not-accounting file = zero hits); S1/S2/S3 all closed at source (negative-metric-vs-cost boundary executed directly: finite_number(-0.5)=True, validate_driver_cost(0,-0.5) aborts); PoisonedJournal widening SAFE (exactly one except-AccountingIntegrityError site, loop.py:371 inside run_unit; journal opens raise at run() startup outside it — no spurious latch); all 13 new tests fail on the parent for the expected reasons. THREE adjacent-seam findings + one schema gap → A3.8 (round 7): T1 launch() failing after on_spawn retention (pidfile OSError) re-raises raw → zero-cost infra retry for a possibly-billed process — the last uncovered interruption point gets the recovery rule; T2 record_infra_event's ordinary append not fail-closed (a torn/failed retry-cost write silently drops spend; distinct from the accepted F3 abort-machinery residue) — OSError → accounting abort; T3 torn FINAL journal line silently vanishes via progress.py's intentional final-line leniency (shared module, other consumers — DO NOT touch) — research Journal.open gains its own final-line integrity check → PoisonedJournal; T4 missing usd key defaults to $0 in validate_journal + spend sums — absent = poisoned, present-0.0 valid. Round 7 = verify the four + a final lifecycle-stage audit (spawn→retention→launch→completion/timeout/cancel→read→validate→sidecar→journal→resume, each stage's failure semantic explicit). The accounting invariant surface is closed end-to-end after A3.8 — clean round 7 ships.
